materials.name: Primary Hot-Rolled Automotive Steel (India BF-BOF)
materials.production_route: Integrated Blast Furnace - Basic Oxygen Furnace
materials.notes_and_limitations: India BF-BOF route steel emission factor imported via CSV pipeline

materials.name: Carbon steel / automotive steel
materials.notes_and_limitations: Primary steel vs recycled/EAF route changes result substantially. Store range and source rather than false-precision single value.

materials.name: Cast iron
materials.grade_or_type: Automotive grey/ductile cast iron (engine blocks, rotors)
materials.notes_and_limitations: Separate iron production from casting energy (e.g., 32.0 MJ/kg in Section 4) if source does so to avoid double counting.

materials.name: Aluminium, primary
materials.notes_and_limitations: Electricity mix is a major driver (coal-heavy grids sit near upper bound); primary vs recycled aluminium must be kept separate.

materials.name: Aluminium, recycled/secondary
materials.notes_and_limitations: Indicative only; scrap allocation method (cut-off vs avoided burden) and remelting route matter significantly.

materials.name: Copper
materials.grade_or_type: Electrolytic tough pitch / wiring & motor winding copper
materials.notes_and_limitations: Ore grade, smelting electricity carbon intensity, and recycled content matter.

materials.name: Plastics (mixed automotive polymers)
materials.grade_or_type: Average automotive polymer mix (PP, ABS, PA, PVC, PU)
materials.notes_and_limitations: Do not use a single factor for all polymers if PP, ABS, PA, PVC etc. can be distinguished in detailed BOM.

materials.name: Rubber / tyre compounds
materials.grade_or_type: Natural & synthetic rubber (SBR/BR) with carbon black
materials.notes_and_limitations: Natural/synthetic rubber production and tyre vulcanisation/manufacturing are distinct modules.

materials.name: Flat glass / automotive glass
materials.notes_and_limitations: Glass production and glass pane forming (16.0 MJ/kg in Section 4) may be separate in inventories.

materials.name: Magnesium alloy
materials.notes_and_limitations: Route and electricity sensitive (Pidgeon process vs electrolytic); usually small mass share (1–5 kg per vehicle).

materials.name: Lithium-ion battery materials / pack
materials.grade_or_type: Traction battery cells & pack (LFP, NMC, etc.)
materials.production_route: Cathode, Anode, Electrolyte, Casing, Pack & Assembly
materials.uncertainty_or_range: Use chemistry- and pack-specific source; commonly modelled per kWh
materials.notes_and_limitations: Do not treat lithium carbonate factor as whole-battery factor; separate cathode, anode, electrolyte, casing, pack and assembly.

materials.name: Manganese (alloying / battery element)
materials.uncertainty_or_range: Mass reported in SWD(2023) 256 (7–8 kg/car); emission factor requires GREET/ecoinvent lookup
materials.notes_and_limitations: Included in EU SWD(2023) 256 representative vehicle composition (8 kg in ICEV/HEV/PHEV, 7 kg in BEV). No screening factor given in Section 2.

materials.name: Glass-fibre reinforced plastic (GFRP)
materials.production_route: Glass Fibre Drawing + Polymer Matrix Moulding
materials.uncertainty_or_range: Mass reported in SWD(2023) 256 (4–9 kg/car); use composite-specific factor or polymer screening proxy with flag
materials.notes_and_limitations: Reported in EU SWD(2023) 256 Table (9 kg ICEV, 4 kg HEV, 5 kg PHEV, 5 kg BEV).

processes.applicability: Steel & aluminium sheet metal body panels / BIW
processes.limitations: Apply only to stamped sheet mass (not total vehicle mass). Reproduced from 1,532 kg reference passenger car study.

processes.applicability: Cast aluminium components (engine head, housing, structural castings)
processes.limitations: Apply only to cast aluminium mass (e.g., 77–93 kg in SWD 2023/256). Ensure primary/secondary aluminium material factor does not already include shape casting.

processes.applicability: Cast iron components (engine block, brake discs, drums)
processes.energy_source: Coke / Natural Gas / Electricity Foundry Mix
processes.limitations: Separate iron production from casting energy if source does so. Apply only to cast iron mass (16–101 kg).

processes.applicability: Copper wiring harnesses, motor windings, cables
processes.limitations: Apply only to drawn copper wire mass (14–35 kg per car).
Secondary brass remelting process factor per kg processed.
Applicable to secondary lead in 12V lead-acid batteries (initial and replacement).

processes.applicability: Machined metal powertrain, chassis, and transmission parts
processes.limitations: Do NOT silently substitute this generic machining factor for polymer injection moulding.

processes.applicability: Forged steel crankshafts, gears, axles, suspension knuckles
processes.limitations: Apply only to forged component mass, not total steel mass.
Glass production and forming may be separate in inventories; check whether flat glass factor already includes forming.

processes.applicability: Body-in-White spot/laser welding (allocated per kg reference in study)
processes.reference_unit: kg processed (Allocated Facility/Reference Unit — Inspect Before Use)
processes.limitations: CRITICAL WARNING: Very high value (920 MJ, 62 kg CO2/kg) represents allocated facility/weld-material basis in PMC10890010 Table 4, NOT per kg of total vehicle mass. Do NOT multiply by total vehicle mass. Prefer plant-level energy per vehicle or per body.

processes.applicability: Vehicle body coating, e-coat, primer, topcoat, curing ovens
processes.reference_unit: kg processed (Allocated Facility/Paint Mass Unit — Inspect Before Use)
processes.limitations: CRITICAL WARNING: 4,167 MJ and 268 kg CO2/kg processed in Table 4 represent allocated paint-shop energy per kg of paint/coating or per vehicle allocation, NOT per kg of vehicle mass. Never multiply by 1,137 kg vehicle mass!

processes.applicability: Assembly plant HVAC, ventilation, and lighting overhead
processes.limitations: CRITICAL WARNING: Represents allocated factory service energy/emissions (3,335 MJ / 225 kg CO2). Treat as per-vehicle allocated factory overhead or inspect original table before applying; do NOT multiply by vehicle mass.

processes.applicability: In-plant conveyors, cranes, forklifts, automated guided vehicles
processes.limitations: Allocated factory service value from PMC10890010 Table 4. Do NOT multiply by total vehicle mass.
Allocated factory service value from PMC10890010 Table 4. Do NOT multiply by total vehicle mass.

processes.applicability: Pneumatic tools, actuators, blow-off, paint atomisation
processes.limitations: Allocated factory service value from PMC10890010 Table 4. Do NOT multiply by total vehicle mass.

processes.process_name: Polymer injection moulding (Data Gap / Not in Table 4)
processes.applicability: Automotive plastics (129–166 kg/car: bumpers, dash, trim)
processes.data_quality_status: Missing in Source Table — Requires External Inventory
processes.limitations: Section 4 explicit instruction: Moulding is not separately listed in Table 4. Use a process-specific inventory with polymer type, machine energy, part mass, cycle time and scrap rate; do NOT silently substitute the generic machining factor.

energy_factors.pathway: Hydrogen from unabated natural gas (SMR without CCS)
energy_factors.factor_type_details: IEA 2024 Global Production Range (~10–12 kg CO2e/kg H2)
energy_factors.critical_caveat: Global production estimate; upstream/midstream methane leakage and capture boundary matter.

energy_factors.factor_type_details: IEA 2024 Global Production Range (~22–26 kg CO2e/kg H2)
energy_factors.critical_caveat: Global production estimate; not a universal India-specific value.

energy_factors.factor_type_details: Calculated from electricity carbon intensity × electrolyser kWh/kg H2
energy_factors.data_quality_status: Formula / Scenario Parameter (Depends on Electricity Factor)
energy_factors.critical_caveat: Not automatically green; calculate using electricity factor and equipment assumptions.

energy_factors.pathway: Indian National Grid Electricity Mix (CEA CDM CO2 Baseline Database)
energy_factors.factor_type_details: Use latest CEA CO2 Baseline Database; specify weighted-average, operating margin, or combined margin
energy_factors.data_quality_status: External Official Source Registered — Import Specific CEA FY Version
energy_factors.critical_caveat: Record fiscal year and whether factor is weighted-average, operating margin, combined margin, etc. Do not assume an older CEA factor is the latest one.

energy_factors.factor_type_details: Lifecycle kg CO2e/kWh from a harmonised LCA source
energy_factors.critical_caveat: Include module manufacturing, balance of system, installation and end-of-life; not zero over lifecycle.

energy_factors.factor_type_details: Lifecycle kg CO2e/kWh from a harmonised LCA source
energy_factors.critical_caveat: Include turbine/material production, installation and end-of-life.

energy_factors.factor_type_details: Tailpipe combustion factor (separate from upstream refining)
energy_factors.data_quality_status: Requires Cited Govt / GHG Inventory Factor Import
energy_factors.critical_caveat: Keep tailpipe and upstream separate; do not compare combustion-only petrol with lifecycle electricity.

energy_factors.pathway: Automotive Petrol — Upstream Extraction, Refining & Distribution (Well-to-Tank)
energy_factors.data_quality_status: Requires Cited Govt / GHG Inventory Factor Import
energy_factors.critical_caveat: Combine with Tank-to-Wheel factor for full Well-to-Wheel comparison against BEV.

energy_factors.factor_type_details: Tailpipe combustion factor (state biodiesel blend assumptions)
energy_factors.data_quality_status: Requires Cited Govt / GHG Inventory Factor Import
energy_factors.critical_caveat: Use a cited government/GHG inventory factor and stated blend assumptions.

energy_factors.pathway: Automotive Diesel — Upstream Fuel Production & Delivery (Well-to-Tank)
energy_factors.data_quality_status: Requires Cited Govt / GHG Inventory Factor Import
energy_factors.critical_caveat: Keep separate from tailpipe combustion factor.

energy_factors.pathway: Compressed Natural Gas — Combustion + Upstream Methane Leakage & Processing
energy_factors.factor_type_details: Combustion CO2 plus upstream methane leakage and compression/processing
energy_factors.data_quality_status: Requires Cited Govt / GHG Inventory Factor Import
energy_factors.critical_caveat: Methane leakage can materially change CO2e.
Land-use change and feedstock assumptions (sugarcane molasses, grain, etc.) can dominate.

vehicles.lca_data_status: Representative Published Archetype (Requires GREET FCEV Stack/Tank Inventory)

use_phase_profiles.profile_name: Standard Passenger Car Functional Unit — ICE/CNG (150,000 km)
use_phase_profiles.maintenance_assumptions: Formula: lifetime_distance_km ÷ fuel_economy × fuel_factor. Separate tailpipe combustion from upstream fuel production.
use_phase_profiles.replacement_parts_notes: Include tyres, 12V lead-acid battery, engine oil/fluids, replacement parts and AC refrigerant leakage where data and boundaries support inclusion.
use_phase_profiles.operating_conditions: Indian urban/highway mixed cycle; state whether ARAI/MIDC test-cycle or real-world on-road consumption is used.

use_phase_profiles.profile_name: Standard Passenger Car Functional Unit — BEV (150,000 km)
use_phase_profiles.maintenance_assumptions: Formula: lifetime_distance_km × electricity_consumption (kWh/km) × grid_factor (kg CO2e/kWh). Include charging losses if wall-to-wheel.
use_phase_profiles.replacement_parts_notes: Tyres, 12V auxiliary lead-acid battery, cabin filter, coolant/brake fluid, refrigerant leakage. Verify if traction battery replacement occurs within 150,000 km.
use_phase_profiles.operating_conditions: Use real-world or test-cycle data consistently and record which it is (HVAC load in Indian summer affects real-world Wh/km).

use_phase_profiles.profile_name: Standard Passenger Car Functional Unit — HEV/PHEV (150,000 km)
use_phase_profiles.maintenance_assumptions: Model electric kilometres (lifetime_km × UF) and combustion kilometres (lifetime_km × (1 - UF)) separately.
use_phase_profiles.replacement_parts_notes: Tyres, 12V battery, engine fluids, brake pads (reduced wear due to regen braking).
use_phase_profiles.operating_conditions: PHEV results depend strongly on electric utility factor (UF) and user charging behaviour.

end_of_life_systems.system_name: End-of-Life Vehicle (ELV) Dismantling & Shredding — Cut-off Approach
end_of_life_systems.dismantling_process: Depollution (fluids, battery, tyres, catalyst removal), dismantling, shredding, magnetic/eddy-current separation
end_of_life_systems.notes: Under Cut-off allocation, secondary materials enter manufacturing with their recycled production factor (e.g. 0.5–2.5 kg CO2e/kg for secondary Al), and no avoided-burden credit is subtracted at EoL to prevent double-counting.

end_of_life_systems.system_name: End-of-Life Vehicle (ELV) — Avoided-Burden Recycling Credit Approach
end_of_life_systems.applicable_material_or_vehicle: Steel, Aluminium, Copper & Traction Battery Metals
end_of_life_systems.dismantling_process: Dismantling, closed/open-loop scrap recovery and remelting
end_of_life_systems.notes: Section 7: State whether recycling credits are avoided-burden, cut-off, or another method. Do not apply both high recycled-content input credits and full end-of-life avoided primary metal credits simultaneously.

end_of_life_systems.system_name: Lithium-Ion Traction Battery End-of-Life Hydrometallurgical / Pyrometallurgical Recycling
end_of_life_systems.applicable_material_or_vehicle: Battery Electric (BEV) / PHEV / HEV Traction Battery Pack
end_of_life_systems.dismantling_process: Pack discharge, disassembly, cell crushing/black mass recovery, hydrometallurgical/pyrometallurgical refining
end_of_life_systems.notes: Section 8 (Archetype 6): Model battery recycling explicitly; recovery value differs sharply between NMC (Co, Ni, Li, Cu) and LFP (Li, Fe, P, Cu, Al).

environmental_indicators.lcia_method: IPCC AR6 / GREET GHG (CO2, CH4, N2O)
environmental_indicators.scope_description: Mandatory baseline indicator across all lifecycle modules (materials, manufacturing, fuel/energy pathway, use phase, end-of-life).
environmental_indicators.status_in_pack: Active & Populated in Reference Data Pack
environmental_indicators.notes: Report both total kg CO2e/vehicle and g CO2e/km over declared lifetime (e.g. 150,000 km).

environmental_indicators.lcia_method: ReCiPe / AWARE / GREET Water Module (Do not mix methods)
environmental_indicators.scope_description: Optional indicator: mining/refining, battery material processing, painting, and power generation cooling.
environmental_indicators.status_in_pack: Schema Supported — Store Only When Defensible Method-Consistent Data Exist
environmental_indicators.notes: Section 7: Store only when the chosen LCIA method and data are available; do not mix indicator methods or combine into an unexplained score.
